Role Overview

Order-to-Cash (O2C) Lead will be responsible to lead the full Order-to-Cash cycle for Reolink Group – including billing, credit management, accounts receivable, cash application, dispute resolution, and revenue realization – to ensure accurate invoicing, disciplined collections, controlled credit exposure, and optimized working capital for all global entities.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead the full global O2C process covering order validation, invoicing, AR booking, collections tracking, cash allocation, credit management, and dispute handling.
• Oversee issuance of all customer invoices/credit notes across regions and channels (online, wholesale, distribution) and ensure correct tax, currency, and terms.
• Set, monitor, and enforce global credit policies: credit limits, payment terms (Net X), and enforcement of credit holds for high-risk accounts.
• Own AR aging control: actively drive collections, escalate overdue accounts, and coordinate with sales teams to resolve commercial disputes.
• Implement and manage cash application processes, including matching incoming bank receipts, marketplace payouts (Amazon / Shopee / etc.), chargebacks, deductions, and short payments.
• Drive DSO performance: analyze overdue buckets, root causes, and recommend corrective actions to improve cash conversion.
• Ensure revenue cut-off and billing completeness at month-end; work with R2R to ensure revenue recognition aligns with delivery / performance obligations.
• Standardize dispute resolution workflow (e.g. short shipment claims, pricing discrepancies, returns), and track resolution turnaround time.
• Develop and maintain standard O2C SOPs, escalation matrices, service level agreements (SLAs) and KPIs for each region / channel.
• Oversee O2C process automation: e-invoicing, dunning automation, auto cash-application, reconciliation against marketplace statements, and RPA-driven reminders.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and external regulatory/tax rules relating to invoicing, indirect tax (VAT/GST), and refund handling.
• Produce regular management reporting and dashboards for CFO / FP&A: AR aging, DSO trend, top delinquent customers, return/chargeback ratio, unallocated cash.

Requirements

• 8+ years hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable / O2C / Credit Control / Cash Application in a multinational or high-volume transactional environment.
• Strong exposure to multi-currency AR, cross-border billing, and international customer terms.
• Experience managing receivables from e-commerce marketplaces / platforms / payment gateways (e.g. Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, Stripe, PayPal) and reconciling settlement statements.
• Proven track record of implementing collections strategy and improving DSO.
• Direct involvement in cash allocation, deductions/claims management, chargeback handling, and dispute escalation.
• Familiarity with revenue cut-off principles and coordination with the Record-to-Report function for period-end close.
• Strong working knowledge of ERP AR modules (SAP / Oracle / NetSuite or equivalent).
• Experience with O2C automation tools such as dunning engines, cash-app matching engines, OCR/remittance capture, RPA bots, or portals.
• Comfortable working with large transaction volumes, high invoice counts, and strict month-end timelines.

Qualifications / Certifications

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
• Professional certification (e.g. CMA, CPA, ACCA) is an advantage but not mandatory if the candidate has very strong O2C/AR background.
• Strong Excel skills (aging modelling, cash allocation tracking, pivot analysis).
• Familiarity with BI dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) for receivables and cash KPIs.
• Knowledge of indirect tax (VAT/GST) and invoicing compliance rules across different jurisdictions is preferred.
• Experience in a shared services / centralized finance hub is preferred.

Role Summary

The Finance Manager – Europe will be responsible for overseeing financial management, reporting, planning, and control for Reolink’s European operations, with a strong focus on e-commerce and marketplace business models. This role will act as a key finance business partner to commercial, operations, and tax teams, ensuring robust financial governance, accurate reporting, and scalable processes across the region.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Manage full-cycle accounting for Europe entities, including GL processing, revenue recognition, and cost allocation across sales channels. 
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with US GAAP and IFRS.
  • Ensure accurate financial consolidation with headquarters and timely reporting of Amazon sales performance, returns, and promotional costs.
  • Maintain and enhance NetSuite operations; develop custom workflows for Amazon reconciliation and inventory tracking.

2. E-commerce & Marketplace Finance

  • Manage financial operations for Amazon (1P & 3P), eBay, and DTC channels.
  • Oversee platform reconciliations, including sales, fees, returns, refunds, and chargebacks.
  • Partner with supply chain teams on inventory costing, write-offs, and margin analysis.

3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Analysis

  • Lead annual budgeting and rolling forecast processes for Europe.
  • Perform variance analysis and provide actionable insights to management.
  • Support pricing, promotion, and profitability analysis by channel and market.

4. Cash, Working Capital & Treasury Support

  • Monitor AR, AP, and inventory levels to optimize working capital.
  • Support multi-currency cash management (EUR, GBP, USD) and cash flow forecasting.
  • Coordinate with Group Treasury on funding, FX exposure, and cash repatriation.

5. Tax, VAT & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Work closely with tax and external advisors on VAT compliance and reporting.
  • Support audits and regulatory reviews across European entities.
  • Act as a finance partner to commercial, operations, and IT teams.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant finance and accounting experience.
  • At least 3 years in e-commerce, marketplace, or digital business environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon (1P & 3P), eBay, Shopify, or similar platforms.
  • Proven experience managing multi-entity, multi-currency European operations.
  • Strong background in financial reporting, controls, and FP&A.

Education & Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) is required.
  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
  • Professional fluency in both English and German is required.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to translate data into business insights.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a cross-cultural environment.
  • Proactive, hands-on, and able to operate in a fast-paced, growing organization.
  • High integrity and strong ownership mindset.

Position Title: Graphic Designer
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Job type: Full-time
Report to: Head of Marketing


Company: Reolink, an innovative leader in intelligent visual technology, is committed to transforming home security through advanced, reliable, and user-centric solutions. Visit reolink.com to learn more.

Job Summary:
We're looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help bring Reolink's security cameras and smart home solutions to life through striking visual design. This role will focus on producing polished graphics across digital and print channels that highlight product features like 4K clarity, color night vision, AI-powered detection, solar power, and weatherproof durability while building trust, reassurance, and aspiration around home and business protection.
You'll work hand-in-hand with the Content Production Manager, Head of Marketing, Copywriter, marketing team, and HQ to create bold, brand-forward visuals for digital campaigns, social media, website assets, product launches, retail displays, email marketing, and packaging. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft and typographic sensibility with a sharp storytelling instinct, able to make security tech feel approachable, modern, and empowering for everyday homeowners and small business owners.

Key Responsibilities:
● Design on-brand graphics for social media, digital ads, website hero content, email marketing, and product launches.
● Create static graphics that clearly communicate key product features (e.g., crystal-clear 4K/16MP resolution, vivid color night vision, 180°/360° panoramic views, solar-powered reliability, and smart AI detection).
● Design packaging, retail displays, point-of-sale materials, and print collateral that align with brand standards.
● Develop marketing assets such as banners, landing pages, one-pagers, spec sheets, and trade show materials.
● Collaborate with the Content Production Manager and cross-functional teams (Social, PR, Retail Marketing, Product) to storyboard and execute campaign concepts.
● Maintain a consistent visual identity that feels trustworthy, innovative, clean, and premium while staying true to global brand guidelines and North American consumer preferences.
● Build and maintain design systems, templates, and style guides that speed up content production across the team.
● Stay current on design trends in consumer tech, home security, and lifestyle content to keep [Company]'s creative output fresh and competitive.
● Archive and organize assets in a digital asset management system, ensuring easy access for teams.
● Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing quick-turn social content with longer campaign deliverables.

Qualifications:
● 3 - 5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, ideally in consumer tech, electronics, home/security products, lifestyle, or related fields.
● Strong portfolio demonstrating brand design, digital and print layout, packaging, and social-first content.
● Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign); familiarity with After Effects or basic motion graphics a plus.
● Excellent understanding of typography, color theory, composition, and visual storytelling.
● Experience designing for multiple platforms and formats (Instagram, TikTok, website, e-commerce, retail, print).
● Ability to translate technical product features into clear, engaging, and accurate visuals.
● Strong collaboration skills; comfortable working with creative, marketing, and agency teams.
● Knowledge of digital content optimization (aspect ratios, file formats, print specs for web/social/retail).
● Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.

*This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days remote each week.

 

Pay Range
$75,000—$90,000 USD

  • 5 Work Days Per Week

  • Office Near Tai Seng MRT, Singapore

  • Medical Benefits Provided 

  • Entitled to Yearly Bonus & Performance Bonus 

Role Summary

  1. This role owns the full costing lifecycle for finished goods and components sourced from factories and subcontractors — from standard cost build-up and BOM validation through to landed cost, variance analysis, and margin reporting.
  2. The successful candidate will be the finance business partner to Operations, Procurement, and Product Engineering, ensuring product costs are accurate, transparent, and defensible, and that the Group has real-time visibility of manufacturing cost drivers across 16 legal entities on a single NetSuite ERP backbone.

Key Responsibilities

Factory & Subcontracting Cost Management

  • Own end-to-end product costing for all CM- and subcontractor-manufactured SKUs, including camera hardware, accessories, and NVR/hub products.
  • Build and maintain standard costs (material, labour, overhead, tooling amortisation) at BOM/routing level in NetSuite; review and approve cost rolls each cycle.
  • Validate CM/subcontractor quotations against BOM cost breakdowns, labour rates, and process yields; challenge quoted costs with fact-based benchmarking.
  • Track and reconcile subcontracting fees, processing charges, tooling/mould amortisation, and NRE (non-recurring engineering) charges billed by factories.
  • Monitor landed cost components — FOB price, freight, duties, insurance — across China, HK, and other sourcing entities.

Variance Analysis & Margin Reporting

  • Perform monthly purchase price variance (PPV), usage variance, and yield/scrap variance analysis by SKU and by factory; investigate and explain root causes with Operations.
  • Analyse standard-vs-actual cost variances arising from engineering changes (ECN), component substitutions, and FX movement on USD/RMB-denominated purchases.
  • Prepare product-level and SKU-level gross margin bridges for management review, highlighting cost trend, mix, and pricing impact.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI) costing — target cost setting, should-cost modelling, and first-article cost validation before mass production.

Inventory & Standard Costing Integrity

  • Maintain integrity of inventory valuation (raw material, WIP, finished goods) across manufacturing and trading entities under group costing policy.
  • Lead periodic standard cost updates / cost roll cycles and coordinate cut-over with Supply Chain to avoid valuation distortions.
  • Review slow-moving / excess & obsolete (E&O) inventory provisioning with Operations and recommend provisioning adjustments.
  • Support physical stock counts and cycle counts at factory / 3PL warehouse locations; reconcile book-to-physical variances.

Business Partnering & Controls

  • Act as finance business partner to Operations, Procurement, and Product Engineering on cost-down initiatives, factory consolidation, and dual-sourcing decisions.
  • Evaluate cost impact of factory transfers, new CM onboarding, and subcontractor contract renegotiations; provide finance sign-off on commercial terms.
  • Design and enforce internal controls over CM/subcontractor billing, tooling asset capitalisation, and consignment inventory arrangements.
  • Support transfer pricing documentation for intercompany manufacturing and processing fee arrangements with the tax/TP team.

Month-End Close & Reporting

  • Prepare costing-related month-end journal entries: cost roll adjustments, PPV/variance postings, tooling amortisation, and provision true-ups.
  • Deliver monthly costing packs to Group Finance covering cost trends, variance summary, and factory scorecards.
  • Support budget and forecast cycles with standard cost assumptions, factory capacity/utilisation inputs, and cost-down targets.
  • Liaise with external auditors on inventory valuation, cost accounting policy, and manufacturing-related audit queries.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

  1. ACCA (part- or fully-qualified) or Diploma in Accounting / Finance; degree holders also welcome.
  2. Minimum 6–8 years' relevant experience in cost accounting / manufacturing finance, with at least 3 years in a hardware / electronics manufacturing or contract manufacturing environment.
  3. Direct experience working with oversea -based contract manufacturers and subcontractors is essential.

  • Position: Group Internal Audit Manager

ROLE PURPOSE 

  • Reolink is a Singapore-headquartered consumer electronics group delivering smart home security cameras and cloud subscription services to customers worldwide.
  • The Group operates 16 legal entities across Asia-Pacific, Europe and North America on a single NetSuite ERP platform, and is strengthening its Singapore headquarters as the Group’s regional hub for finance, governance and control.
  • This newly created role will establish and lead the Group’s internal audit and governance function. Reporting to the Group CFO, with a functional line to the Audit Committee / Board, the incumbent will build a risk-based assurance framework fit for a fast-growing, multi-jurisdiction group and support the organisation’s journey toward listed-company governance standards. 

REQUIREMENTS 

  1. Degree in Accountancy, Finance or related discipline. 
  2. Professional qualification required: CA (Singapore) / ACCA / CPA / ICAEW. CIA, CISA or CRMA is a strong advantage. 
  3. 8–12 years of experience in internal audit, risk advisory or external audit, including at least 3 years with a Big 4 or established risk advisory firm. 
  4. Minimum 3 years in an in-house internal audit or governance lead role within a multinational or listed group. 
  5. Proven experience auditing multi-entity, cross-border operations across APAC, Europe and/or the US. 
  6. Hands-on experience with IPO readiness, SOX or SGX/HKEX internal control requirements is highly preferred. 
  7. Exposure to consumer electronics, e-commerce, SaaS / subscription or manufacturing / supply-chain businesses is an advantage. 
  8. Working knowledge of NetSuite or other cloud ERP control environments. 
  9. Strong command of COSO, IIA Standards and ERM frameworks. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Internal Audit

  • Develop and deliver the annual risk-based internal audit plan covering all Group entities, business processes and IT systems. 
  • Lead end-to-end audits: planning, fieldwork, testing, reporting and follow-up, including in-person and remote reviews of overseas subsidiaries. 
  • Assess design and operating effectiveness of controls over order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory and supply chain, payroll, treasury, intercompany and financial close. 
  • Review cloud subscription and e-commerce revenue processes, including platform settlements, payment gateways, refunds and chargebacks. 
  • Track management action plans to closure and report status to the CFO and Audit Committee. 

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Build and maintain the Group Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework and risk register, with periodic risk assessments across entities. 
  • Develop the Group policy framework: delegation of authority, related-party transactions, anti-bribery & corruption, whistleblowing, conflict of interest and code of conduct. 
  • Maintain the Group entity governance calendar: board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, director and registered-office changes, and entity compliance obligations across jurisdictions. 
  • Support regulatory engagements, grant and incentive compliance (e.g. EDB programmes) and audit trails required by government agencies. 

Internal Control Framework & IPO Readiness

  • Document entity-level controls and process-level Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) aligned to COSO 2013. 

Tax & Regulatory Audit Support

  • Support Group Tax on indirect tax and corporate tax inspections in overseas jurisdictions, including evidence gathering, documentation integrity and substance reviews. 
  • Review intercompany arrangements, transfer-pricing documentation trails and intercompany settlement controls for audit defensibility. 

IT & Systems Controls

  • Review NetSuite ERP controls: user access, segregation of duties, approval workflows, master data changes and system interfaces. 
  • Assess IT general controls, data privacy (PDPA / GDPR) and cybersecurity governance in partnership with IT. 

Shared Services & Continuous Improvement

  • Embed control design into the Group Finance Shared Services Centre and process migrations, ensuring controls are maintained through transitions. 
  • Introduce data analytics and continuous control monitoring to increase audit coverage and efficiency. 
  • Conduct special reviews and fraud investigations as directed by Group Finance or Board.
